scripts.dev:ai: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p = spawn(process.platform === 'win32' ? '.\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : '.venv/bin/python', ['main.py'], { cwd: 'apps/ai', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); p.on('exit', code => process.exit(code));"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "WEB,API,AI" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:ui && npm run build:web && npm run build:api
